name: Grade 7 Mathematics Question Set
description: 300 questions covering: Number Systems & Integers, Data Handling & Symmetry, Geometry & Mensuration, Fractions, Decimals & Quantities, Algebra & Equations.

questions.problem: What is the additive inverse of -15?
questions.explanation:
Concept: The additive inverse of a number a is -a such that a + (-a) = 0.

Step-by-Step Solution: Additive inverse of -15 is -(-15) = 15.

Common Mistake: Confusing additive inverse with multiplicative inverse (-1/15).

Quick Tip: Change the sign of the number.

questions.problem: Evaluate: (-8) + (-5).
questions.explanation:
Concept: Adding two negative integers yields a negative integer with the sum of their absolute values.

Step-by-Step Solution: (-8) + (-5) = -(8 + 5) = -13.

Common Mistake: Multiplying signs to get positive +13.

Quick Tip: Same sign addition: add values and keep negative sign.

questions.problem: Evaluate: (-12) × (-4).
questions.explanation:
Concept: The product of two negative integers is a positive integer.

Step-by-Step Solution: (-12) × (-4) = +(12 × 4) = 48.

Common Mistake: Writing -48.

Quick Tip: Negative × Negative = Positive.

questions.problem: What is the value of 5^0?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Any non-zero base raised to the power of 0 equals 1 (a^0 = 1).

Step-by-Step Solution: 5^0 = 1.

Common Mistake: Thinking 5^0 = 0.

Quick Tip: Anything raised to power 0 equals 1.

questions.problem: Express 2^3 in expanded form.
questions.explanation:
Concept: a^n means multiplying base a by itself n times.

Step-by-Step Solution: 2^3 = 2 × 2 × 2 = 8.

Common Mistake: Confusing 2^3 with 2 × 3 = 6.

Quick Tip: 2^3 means 2 multiplied 3 times.

questions.problem: Which rational number is in standard form?
questions.explanation:
Concept: A rational number p/q is in standard form if q > 0 and HCF(|p|, q) = 1.

Step-by-Step Solution: In -3/7, denominator is positive (7) and HCF(3, 7) = 1.

Common Mistake: Choosing 3/-7 (negative denominator is not standard form).

Quick Tip: Denominator must be positive and fraction must be in lowest terms.

questions.problem: Evaluate: (-20) ÷ 4.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Dividing a negative integer by a positive integer gives a negative quotient.

Step-by-Step Solution: (-20) ÷ 4 = -5.

Common Mistake: Writing +5.

Quick Tip: Negative ÷ Positive = Negative.

questions.problem: What is the multiplicative inverse (reciprocal) of -4/5?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Multiplicative inverse of p/q is q/p such that (p/q) × (q/p) = 1.

Step-by-Step Solution: Reciprocal of -4/5 is -5/4.

Common Mistake: Changing the sign to +4/5 (that is additive inverse!).

Quick Tip: Reciprocal flips the fraction upside down without changing its sign.

questions.problem: Simplify: 3^4 × 3^2.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Product law of exponents: a^m × a^n = a^(m+n).

Step-by-Step Solution: 3^4 × 3^2 = 3^(4+2) = 3^6.

Common Mistake: Multiplying exponents: 3^(4×2) = 3^8.

Quick Tip: When bases are same and multiplied, ADD the exponents.

questions.problem: What is the value of (-1)^100?
questions.explanation:
Concept: (-1) raised to an EVEN power is +1; to an ODD power is -1.

Step-by-Step Solution: Since 100 is even, (-1)^100 = 1.

Common Mistake: Writing -1.

Quick Tip: Even power of negative number is positive.

questions.problem: Write 59,000 in scientific standard notation.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Scientific notation is k × 10^n where 1 <= k < 10.

Step-by-Step Solution: 59,000 = 5.9 × 10,000 = 5.9 × 10^4.

Common Mistake: Writing 59 × 10^3 (59 is not between 1 and 10).

Quick Tip: First factor must be between 1 and 10.

questions.problem: Which of the following is equivalent to -5/8?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Multiply numerator and denominator by -2: (-5 × -2) / (8 × -2) = 10/-16 = -5/8.

Step-by-Step Solution: 10/-16 = -10/16 = -5/8.

Common Mistake: Choosing 10/16 (which is positive).

Quick Tip: Single negative sign makes the fraction negative.

questions.problem: What is the arithmetic mean of 4, 8, 12, 16?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Mean = Sum / Count = (4 + 8 + 12 + 16) / 4 = 40 / 4 = 10.

Step-by-Step Solution: 40 / 4 = 10.

Common Mistake: Reporting sum 40.

Quick Tip: Sum / 4 = 10.

questions.problem: What is the mode of the dataset: 3, 5, 7, 5, 2, 5, 8, 5?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Mode is the observation that occurs most frequently.

Step-by-Step Solution: 5 occurs 4 times, which is the highest frequency.

Common Mistake: Choosing 8 (largest value).

Quick Tip: Mode = Most frequent value.

questions.problem: If two lines intersect, the vertically opposite angles are:
questions.explanation:
Concept: Vertically opposite angles formed by two intersecting lines are always equal.

Step-by-Step Solution: Equal.

Common Mistake: Thinking they add up to 180°.

Quick Tip: Vertically opposite angles are EQUAL.

questions.problem: How many medians can a triangle have?
questions.explanation:
Concept: A triangle has 3 vertices, so it has 3 medians (one from each vertex).

Step-by-Step Solution: 3 medians.

Common Mistake: Thinking only 1 median.

Quick Tip: 3 vertices ⇒ 3 medians.

questions.problem: An altitude of a triangle is a line segment from a vertex:
questions.explanation:
Concept: An altitude is the perpendicular dropped from a vertex to the opposite side.

Step-by-Step Solution: Perpendicular to the opposite side.

Common Mistake: Confusing altitude with median (which joins to midpoint).

Quick Tip: Altitude = Height = Perpendicular (90°).
choices: To the midpoint of the opposite side

questions.problem: What is the complement of 35°?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Complementary angle = 90° - Given angle.

Step-by-Step Solution: 90° - 35° = 55°.

Common Mistake: Subtracting from 180° (giving 145°).

Quick Tip: Complement = 90° - angle.

questions.problem: What is the supplement of 110°?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Supplementary angle = 180° - Given angle.

Step-by-Step Solution: 180° - 110° = 70°.

Common Mistake: Subtracting from 90°.

Quick Tip: Supplement = 180° - angle.

questions.problem: How many faces does a triangular pyramid (tetrahedron) have?
questions.explanation:
Concept: A triangular pyramid has 1 triangular base and 3 triangular side faces = 4 faces.

Step-by-Step Solution: 4 faces.

Common Mistake: Counting only side faces (3).

Quick Tip: Base + 3 sides = 4 faces.

questions.problem: What 3D shape is formed by folding a net with 6 identical squares?
questions.explanation:
Concept: A cube net consists of 6 identical connected squares.

Step-by-Step Solution: Cube.

Common Mistake: Choosing cuboid.

Quick Tip: 6 square faces = Cube.

questions.problem: What is the measure of each angle in an equilateral triangle?
questions.explanation:
Concept: An equilateral triangle has 3 equal angles: 180° / 3 = 60°.

Step-by-Step Solution: 180° / 3 = 60°.

Common Mistake: Writing 90°.

Quick Tip: All 3 angles = 60°.

questions.problem: If two angles add up to 90°, they are called:
questions.explanation:
Concept: Two angles are complementary if the sum of their measures is 90°.

Step-by-Step Solution: Complementary angles.

Common Mistake: Confusing with supplementary (180°).

Quick Tip: C for Corner (90°) = Complementary.

questions.problem: If two angles add up to 180°, they are called:
questions.explanation:
Concept: Two angles are supplementary if the sum of their measures is 180°.

Step-by-Step Solution: Supplementary angles.

Common Mistake: Confusing with complementary (90°).

Quick Tip: S for Straight (180°) = Supplementary.

questions.problem: What is the sum of interior angles of any triangle?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Angle sum property of a triangle: total interior angle sum is 180°.

Step-by-Step Solution: 180°.

Common Mistake: Thinking 360° (which is for quadrilateral).

Quick Tip: Sum of angles of triangle = 180°.

questions.problem: What is the formula for the area of a circle?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Area of a circle of radius r is A = π r^2.

Step-by-Step Solution: π r^2.

Common Mistake: Confusing area (π r^2) with circumference (2 π r).

Quick Tip: Area has square units (r^2).

questions.problem: What is the formula for the circumference of a circle?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Circumference C = 2 π r (or π d).

Step-by-Step Solution: 2 π r.

Common Mistake: Choosing π r^2.

Quick Tip: Circumference = 2 π r.

questions.problem: What is the formula for the area of a parallelogram?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Area of parallelogram = Base × Height (b × h).

Step-by-Step Solution: Base × Height.

Common Mistake: Including 1/2 (which is for triangle!).

Quick Tip: Parallelogram area = Base × Height.

questions.problem: What is the formula for the area of a triangle?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Area of triangle = 1/2 × Base × Height.

Step-by-Step Solution: 1/2 × b × h.

Common Mistake: Forgetting the 1/2 factor.

Quick Tip: Triangle is half of a parallelogram: 1/2 × b × h.

questions.problem: State the Pythagoras theorem for a right-angled triangle with hypotenuse c and legs a, b.
questions.explanation:
Concept: In a right triangle, Hypotenuse^2 = Base^2 + Altitude^2 (c^2 = a^2 + b^2).

Step-by-Step Solution: c^2 = a^2 + b^2.

Common Mistake: Writing c = a + b.

Quick Tip: Hypotenuse squared = sum of squares of other two sides.

questions.problem: What is the sum of an integer and its additive inverse?
questions.explanation:
Concept: a + (-a) = 0 by definition of additive inverse.

Step-by-Step Solution: a + (-a) = 0.

Common Mistake: Thinking sum is 1.

Quick Tip: Additive inverse sum is ALWAYS 0.

questions.problem: Evaluate: (-1)^3.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Odd power of -1 is -1.

Step-by-Step Solution: (-1) × (-1) × (-1) = -1.

Common Mistake: Writing +1.

Quick Tip: (-1)^odd = -1.

questions.problem: What is 1/2 of 1/4?
questions.explanation:
Concept: 1/2 × 1/4 = 1/8.

Step-by-Step Solution: 1/2 × 1/4 = 1/8.

Common Mistake: Adding 1/2 + 1/4 = 3/4.

Quick Tip: Multiply numerators and denominators.

questions.problem: Convert 0.75 into a fraction.
questions.explanation:
Concept: 0.75 = 75/100 = 3/4.

Step-by-Step Solution: 75/100 = 3/4.

Common Mistake: Writing 75/10.

Quick Tip: 0.75 = 3/4.

questions.problem: If Cost Price (CP) = ₹500 and Selling Price (SP) = ₹600, what is the Profit?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Profit = SP - CP.

Step-by-Step Solution: 600 - 500 = ₹100.

Common Mistake: Adding CP and SP.

Quick Tip: Profit = SP - CP.

questions.problem: Divide: 2.4 ÷ 4.
questions.explanation:
Concept: 24 ÷ 4 = 6. Place decimal at 1 place: 0.6.

Step-by-Step Solution: 2.4 ÷ 4 = 0.6.

Common Mistake: Writing 0.06.

Quick Tip: 24/4 = 6, so 2.4/4 = 0.6.

questions.problem: What is the ratio of 50 paise to ₹2 in simplest form?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Convert quantities to same unit before finding ratio.

Step-by-Step Solution: 50 / 200 = 1 / 4 ⇒ 1 : 4.

Common Mistake: Writing 50 : 2 = 25 : 1 without converting units.

Quick Tip: Convert ₹2 to 200 paise first.

questions.problem: What is 15% of 200?
questions.explanation:
Concept: 15% of 200 = (15/100) × 200 = 15 × 2 = 30.

Step-by-Step Solution: 15 × 2 = 30.

Common Mistake: Writing 15.

Quick Tip: 15 × 2 = 30.

questions.problem: If an item bought for ₹80 is sold for ₹60, there is a:
questions.explanation:
Concept: Since CP > SP, there is a Loss = CP - SP = 80 - 60 = ₹20.

Step-by-Step Solution: Loss = 80 - 60 = ₹20.

Common Mistake: Calling it a profit of ₹20.

Quick Tip: CP > SP means Loss.

questions.problem: Convert 0.08 into a percentage.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Multiply decimal by 100%.

Step-by-Step Solution: 0.08 × 100% = 8%.

Common Mistake: Writing 80%.

Quick Tip: Shift decimal 2 places right = 8%.

Concept: (2×9)/(3×10) = 18/30. Simplify by dividing by 6: 3/5.

Step-by-Step Solution: 18/30 = 3/5.

Common Mistake: Writing 18/30 without simplifying.

Quick Tip: Cancel common factor 3 and 2.

questions.problem: What is the reciprocal of 7?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Reciprocal of integer a is 1/a.

Step-by-Step Solution: Reciprocal of 7 is 1/7.

Common Mistake: Writing -7 (additive inverse).

Quick Tip: Flip 7/1 to 1/7.

questions.problem: What is the degree of a constant non-zero term like 7?
questions.explanation:
Concept: A constant non-zero number can be written as 7x^0, so its degree is 0.

Step-by-Step Solution: Degree of non-zero constant = 0.

Common Mistake: Thinking degree is 1.

Quick Tip: Constant term has degree 0.

questions.problem: Evaluate: 4x when x = -3.
questions.explanation:
Concept: 4 × (-3) = -12.

Step-by-Step Solution: 4 × (-3) = -12.

Common Mistake: Writing +12.

Quick Tip: Positive × Negative = Negative.

questions.problem: What is 0.5 × 0.2?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Multiply without decimal: 5 × 2 = 10. Total decimal places = 1 + 1 = 2. Result = 0.10 = 0.1.

Step-by-Step Solution: 0.5 × 0.2 = 0.1.

Common Mistake: Writing 0.01.

Quick Tip: 5 × 2 = 10, shift decimal 2 places left = 0.10 = 0.1.

questions.problem: Convert 3/5 into a percentage.
questions.explanation:
Concept: To convert fraction to percentage, multiply by 100%.

Step-by-Step Solution: 3/5 × 100% = 3 × 20% = 60%.

Common Mistake: Writing 30%.

Quick Tip: Multiply by 100.

questions.problem: What is 25% expressed as a fraction in simplest form?
questions.explanation:
Concept: 25% = 25/100 = 1/4.

Step-by-Step Solution: 25/100 = 1/4.

Common Mistake: Writing 1/5.

Quick Tip: 25/100 simplifies to 1/4.

questions.problem: What is the Simple Interest formula?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Simple Interest I = Principal(P) × Rate(R) × Time(T) / 100.

Step-by-Step Solution: I = (P × R × T) / 100.

Common Mistake: Confusing with compound interest.

Quick Tip: P × R × T / 100.

questions.problem: Identify the coefficient of x in the expression 5x - 3.
questions.explanation:
Concept: The numerical factor of a term with variables is its numerical coefficient.

Step-by-Step Solution: In 5x, the numerical coefficient of x is 5.

Common Mistake: Writing -3 (which is constant term).

Quick Tip: Number multiplying x is coefficient of x.

questions.problem: Solve the equation: x + 7 = 12.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Transpose +7 to RHS: x = 12 - 7 = 5.

Step-by-Step Solution: x = 12 - 7 = 5.

Common Mistake: Adding 12 + 7 = 19.

Quick Tip: Subtract 7 from both sides.

questions.problem: Which of the following is a monomial?
questions.explanation:
Concept: An expression containing only one term is a monomial.

Step-by-Step Solution: 7xy has only 1 term.

Common Mistake: Choosing 7x + y (which has 2 terms, binomial).

Quick Tip: Single term = Monomial.

questions.problem: Solve: 3y = 21.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Divide both sides by 3: y = 21 / 3 = 7.

Step-by-Step Solution: y = 21 / 3 = 7.

Common Mistake: Multiplying 21 × 3 = 63.

Quick Tip: Divide by coefficient of y.

questions.problem: Identify the like terms: 3x, 4y, -5x, 2z.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Terms having the same algebraic variables are like terms.

Step-by-Step Solution: 3x and -5x both contain variable x.

Common Mistake: Choosing 3x and 4y.

Quick Tip: Same variable = Like terms.

questions.problem: Find the value of 2x + 3 when x = 4.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Substitute x = 4 into expression.

Step-by-Step Solution: 2(4) + 3 = 8 + 3 = 11.

Common Mistake: Writing 24 + 3 = 27.

Quick Tip: 2x means 2 × x.

questions.problem: Solve: z / 4 = 5.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Multiply both sides by 4: z = 5 × 4 = 20.

Step-by-Step Solution: z = 20.

Common Mistake: Adding 5 + 4 = 9.

Quick Tip: Multiply by denominator.

questions.problem: What is the degree of the term 4x^3?
questions.explanation:
Concept: The degree of a single-variable monomial term is the exponent of its variable.

Step-by-Step Solution: In 4x^3, exponent of x is 3.

Common Mistake: Writing 4 (coefficient).

Quick Tip: Exponent = Degree.

questions.problem: Add: 3a + 5a.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Add coefficients of like terms: (3 + 5)a = 8a.

Step-by-Step Solution: 3a + 5a = 8a.

Common Mistake: Writing 8a^2 (adding exponents is for multiplication!).

Quick Tip: Adding terms keeps the variable same (8a).

questions.problem: Write as an algebraic expression: "5 added to twice a number x".
questions.explanation:
Concept: Twice x = 2x. Add 5 = 2x + 5.

Step-by-Step Solution: 2x + 5.

Common Mistake: Writing 2(x + 5).

Quick Tip: Twice x is 2x, then add 5.

questions.problem: Solve: p - 9 = -3.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Transpose -9 to RHS: p = -3 + 9 = 6.

Step-by-Step Solution: p = -3 + 9 = 6.

Common Mistake: Writing -12.

Quick Tip: Transposing -9 becomes +9.

questions.problem: Subtract 4x from 9x.
questions.explanation:
Concept: 9x - 4x = (9 - 4)x = 5x.

Step-by-Step Solution: 9x - 4x = 5x.

Common Mistake: Subtracting 9x from 4x (-5x).

Quick Tip: "Subtract A from B" means B - A.

questions.problem: Evaluate: (-15) × 8 + (-15) × 2 using distributive property.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Distributive property: a × b + a × c = a × (b + c).

Step-by-Step Solution: (-15) × 8 + (-15) × 2 = (-15) × (8 + 2) = (-15) × 10 = -150.

Common Mistake: Multiplying each pair separately and making calculation error.

Quick Tip: Take out common factor (-15) first.

Concept: Quotient law: a^m ÷ a^n = a^(m-n). Product law: a^m × a^n = a^(m+n).

Step-by-Step Solution: 2^5 ÷ 2^3 = 2^(5-3) = 2^2. Then 2^2 × 2^4 = 2^(2+4) = 2^6.

Common Mistake: Dividing exponents: 2^(5/3).

Quick Tip: Subtract exponents for division, add exponents for multiplication.

questions.problem: Find the sum of -3/5 and 2/3.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Find LCM of denominators (5, 3) = 15.

Step-by-Step Solution: -3/5 = -9/15. 2/3 = 10/15. Sum = (-9 + 10)/15 = 1/15.

Common Mistake: Adding numerators directly: (-3+2)/(5+3) = -1/8.

Quick Tip: Convert to like denominators before adding.

questions.problem: At sunrise, temperature was -4°C. By noon, it rose by 9°C. What was the temperature at noon?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Temperature rise means addition.

Step-by-Step Solution: Noon temperature = (-4) + 9 = 5°C.

Common Mistake: Subtracting 9 from -4 (-13°C).

Quick Tip: "Rose by" means ADD.

Concept: a^0 = 1 for any non-zero a.

Step-by-Step Solution: 3^0 + 4^0 + 5^0 = 1 + 1 + 1 = 3. 3 × 2^2 = 3 × 4 = 12.

Common Mistake: Taking 3^0 = 0 (getting 0).

Quick Tip: Each non-zero term with exponent 0 equals 1.

questions.problem: Find a rational number exactly halfway between -1/2 and 1/2.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Midpoint = (a + b) / 2.

Step-by-Step Solution: ((-1/2) + 1/2) / 2 = 0 / 2 = 0.

Common Mistake: Writing 1/4.

Quick Tip: Sum of -1/2 and +1/2 is 0.

questions.problem: Express 0.00034 in scientific standard notation.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Move decimal point 4 places right: 0.00034 = 3.4 × 10^-4.

Step-by-Step Solution: 3.4 × 10^-4.

Common Mistake: Using positive exponent 10^4.

Quick Tip: Small decimals (<1) have negative powers of 10.

questions.problem: In a test (+4) marks are given for correct answers and (-2) for incorrect. Gurpreet scored 20 marks. If she got 10 correct, how many incorrect answers did she attempt?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Score = (Correct × 4) + (Incorrect × -2).

Step-by-Step Solution: 10 × 4 = 40. 40 + (Incorrect × -2) = 20 ⇒ Incorrect × -2 = -20 ⇒ Incorrect = 10.

Common Mistake: Dividing 20 by 2 directly.

Quick Tip: Total marks from correct = 40. Lost marks = 40 - 20 = 20. 20 ÷ 2 = 10 incorrect.

questions.problem: Subtract -7/9 from -2/9.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Subtracting a means adding (-a).

Step-by-Step Solution: (-2/9) - (-7/9) = -2/9 + 7/9 = (-2 + 7)/9 = 5/9.

Common Mistake: Writing -9/9.

Quick Tip: -2 - (-7) = -2 + 7 = +5.

questions.problem: Find the product: (-2) × (-3) × (-4) × (-5).
questions.explanation:
Concept: An EVEN number of negative factors gives a POSITIVE product.

Step-by-Step Solution: 4 negative factors ⇒ positive. 2 × 3 × 4 × 5 = 120.

Common Mistake: Writing -120.

Quick Tip: Even number of negative signs = Positive result.

Concept: Power law: (a^m)^n = a^(mn). Quotient law: a^m ÷ a^n = a^(m-n).

Step-by-Step Solution: (5^3)^2 = 5^6. 5^6 ÷ 5^4 = 5^(6-4) = 5^2 = 25.

Common Mistake: Adding 3 + 2 = 5 for power of power.

Quick Tip: (5^3)^2 = 5^6; 5^6 / 5^4 = 5^2 = 25.

questions.problem: Arrange in ascending order: -3/4, -5/6, -2/3.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Convert to like denominator (12): -3/4 = -9/12, -5/6 = -10/12, -2/3 = -8/12.

Step-by-Step Solution: Compare numerators: -10 < -9 < -8. Ascending: -10/12 (-5/6) < -9/12 (-3/4) < -8/12 (-2/3).

Common Mistake: Thinking -10 is greater than -8.

Quick Tip: For negative numbers, larger absolute value means SMALLER value.

Concept: Division of fractions: (a/b) ÷ (c/d) = (a/b) × (d/c).

Step-by-Step Solution: (-4/9) × (3/2) = (-4 × 3)/(9 × 2) = -12/18 = -2/3.

Common Mistake: Dividing numerators and denominators directly.

Quick Tip: Multiply by reciprocal of second fraction.

questions.problem: What power of 2 is equal to 64?
questions.explanation:
Concept: 2^n = 64. Factorize 64: 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 = 2^6.

Step-by-Step Solution: 2^6 = 64, so n = 6.

Common Mistake: Writing 8 (since 8 × 8 = 64).

Quick Tip: Count factors of 2: 2^1=2, 2^2=4, 2^3=8, 2^4=16, 2^5=32, 2^6=64.

questions.problem: A submarine is at 250 m below sea level. It descends another 120 m. What is its new position?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Below sea level represents negative integer. Descend means further subtraction.

Step-by-Step Solution: (-250) + (-120) = -370 m.

Common Mistake: Subtracting -120 to get -130 m.

Quick Tip: Descend further below sea level = more negative.

Concept: (-3)^(3+2) = (-3)^5.

Step-by-Step Solution: (-3)^5 = -(3^5) = -243.

Common Mistake: Writing +243 (odd power of negative number is negative).

Quick Tip: Odd power of negative base is ALWAYS negative.

questions.problem: Subtract (a - b) from (a + b).
questions.explanation:
Concept: (a + b) - (a - b) = a + b - a + b = 2b.

Step-by-Step Solution: a + b - a + b = 2b.

Common Mistake: Writing 0 (forgetting to change sign of -b).

Quick Tip: -(-b) = +b.

Concept: Cross multiply: 3(x - 1) = 2(x + 2) ⇒ 3x - 3 = 2x + 4 ⇒ 3x - 2x = 4 + 3 ⇒ x = 7.

Step-by-Step Solution: 3x - 3 = 2x + 4 ⇒ x = 7.

Common Mistake: Writing 3x - 1 = 2x + 2.

Quick Tip: Multiply entire numerator by denominator.

questions.problem: In an isosceles triangle, the vertex angle is 40°. Find the measure of each equal base angle b.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Angle sum of triangle = 180°. 40° + 2b = 180° ⇒ 2b = 140° ⇒ b = 70°.

Step-by-Step Solution: 2b = 140° ⇒ b = 70°.

Common Mistake: Forgetting there are 2 equal base angles (140°).

Quick Tip: 180° - 40° = 140°; 140° / 2 = 70°.

questions.problem: If x = -2, evaluate x^3 - 3x^2 + 2x - 5.
tags: Evaluating cubic polynomial at negative value

questions.problem: Find a number such that 1/4 of the number is 3 more than 7.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Let number be x. 1/4 x = 7 + 3 = 10 ⇒ x = 10 × 4 = 40.

Step-by-Step Solution: x/4 = 10 ⇒ x = 40.

Common Mistake: Writing x/4 = 7 - 3 = 4.

Quick Tip: 3 more than 7 is 10.

questions.problem: Simplify: 2(a^2 + ab) + 3 - ab.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Expand: 2a^2 + 2ab + 3 - ab. Combine like terms: 2a^2 + (2ab - ab) + 3 = 2a^2 + ab + 3.

Step-by-Step Solution: 2a^2 + ab + 3.

Common Mistake: Not expanding bracket properly.

Quick Tip: 2(ab) - ab = ab.

Concept: 0.5x = 3.5 + 1.5 = 5.0 ⇒ x = 5.0 / 0.5 = 10.

Step-by-Step Solution: 0.5x = 5 ⇒ x = 10.

Common Mistake: Dividing 5 by 0.5 to get 1.

Quick Tip: 5 ÷ 0.5 = 10.

questions.problem: If the length of a rectangle is 3 cm more than its breadth b, write its perimeter in terms of b.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Breadth = b. Length = b + 3. Perimeter = 2(L + B) = 2(b + 3 + b) = 2(2b + 3) = 4b + 6.

Step-by-Step Solution: Perimeter = 2(2b + 3) = 4b + 6.

Common Mistake: Forgetting to double the length and breadth sum.

Quick Tip: 2 × (b + b + 3) = 2 × (2b + 3) = 4b + 6.

Concept: x/3 = -3/2 - 5/2 = -8/2 = -4. x = -4 × 3 = -12.

Step-by-Step Solution: x/3 = -4 ⇒ x = -12.

Common Mistake: Writing -3/2 - 5/2 = +2/2.

Quick Tip: -3/2 - 5/2 = -8/2 = -4.

questions.problem: Find the perimeter of a triangle with side lengths (2x + 1), (3x - 2), and (x + 4).
questions.explanation:
Concept: Perimeter = (2x + 1) + (3x - 2) + (x + 4) = (2 + 3 + 1)x + (1 - 2 + 4) = 6x + 3.

Step-by-Step Solution: 6x + 3.

Common Mistake: Adding constants incorrectly (1 - 2 + 4 = 3).

Quick Tip: Combine like x-terms and like constant terms.

Concept: Expand brackets: 8y - 4 = 3y + 6 ⇒ 8y - 3y = 6 + 4 ⇒ 5y = 10 ⇒ y = 2.

Step-by-Step Solution: 5y = 10 ⇒ y = 2.

Common Mistake: Expanding brackets incorrectly as 8y - 1.

Quick Tip: 4 × (2y - 1) = 8y - 4.

questions.problem: What must be added to x^2 + xy + y^2 to get 2x^2 + 3xy?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Required expression = (2x^2 + 3xy) - (x^2 + xy + y^2) = 2x^2 + 3xy - x^2 - xy - y^2 = x^2 + 2xy - y^2.

Step-by-Step Solution: x^2 + 2xy - y^2.

Common Mistake: Adding both expressions together.

Quick Tip: Required = Target - Given.

questions.problem: Solve: 7x - 2 = 5x + 10.
questions.explanation:
Concept: 7x - 5x = 10 + 2 ⇒ 2x = 12 ⇒ x = 6.

Step-by-Step Solution: 2x = 12 ⇒ x = 6.

Common Mistake: Adding 7x + 5x = 12x.

Quick Tip: 7x - 5x = 2x; 10 + 2 = 12.

questions.problem: What is the coefficient of y^2 in -8xy^2?
questions.explanation:
Concept: The coefficient of y^2 is everything multiplying y^2 in the term.

Step-by-Step Solution: In -8xy^2, -8x is multiplying y^2.

Common Mistake: Writing only -8 (which is numerical coefficient).

Quick Tip: Coefficient of y^2 includes all remaining factors (-8x).

questions.problem: A line segment of length 35 cm is divided into two parts such that one part is 4 times the other. Find the length of the shorter part.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Let shorter part = x. Longer part = 4x. Total = 5x = 35 ⇒ x = 7 cm.

Step-by-Step Solution: 5x = 35 ⇒ x = 7 cm.

Common Mistake: Dividing 35 by 4 directly.

Quick Tip: x + 4x = 5x = 35 ⇒ x = 7 cm.

questions.problem: Evaluate: (a + b)^2 - (a - b)^2 when a = 3 and b = 4.
questions.explanation:
Concept: (3 + 4)^2 - (3 - 4)^2 = 7^2 - (-1)^2 = 49 - 1 = 48 (or 4ab = 4 × 3 × 4 = 48).

Step-by-Step Solution: 49 - 1 = 48.

Common Mistake: Writing 49 - (-1) = 50.

Quick Tip: (-1)^2 is +1.

Concept: Step 1: (2/3)x = 7 + 5 = 12. Step 2: x = 12 × (3/2) = 18.

Step-by-Step Solution: (2/3)x = 12 ⇒ x = 18.

Common Mistake: Multiplying 12 by 2/3 (getting 8).

Quick Tip: Multiply by reciprocal 3/2.

questions.problem: Raju's father's age is 5 years more than 3 times Raju's age. If father is 44 years old, how old is Raju?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Let Raju's age = x. 3x + 5 = 44 ⇒ 3x = 39 ⇒ x = 13 years.

Step-by-Step Solution: 3x = 39 ⇒ x = 13.

Common Mistake: Subtracting 5 from 44 to get 39 and forgetting to divide by 3.

Quick Tip: 3x + 5 = 44 ⇒ 3x = 39 ⇒ x = 13.

questions.problem: The sum of three consecutive integers is 51. Find the middle integer.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Let integers be x - 1, x, x + 1. Sum = 3x = 51 ⇒ x = 17.

Step-by-Step Solution: 3x = 51 ⇒ x = 17.

Common Mistake: Dividing 51 by 3 to get 17 and calling it smallest integer.

Quick Tip: Sum of 3 consecutive integers = 3 × (middle integer).

questions.problem: Subtract (2x - 3y) from (5x + 4y).
questions.explanation:
Concept: (5x + 4y) - (2x - 3y) = 5x + 4y - 2x + 3y = (5x - 2x) + (4y + 3y) = 3x + 7y.

Step-by-Step Solution: 3x + 7y.

Common Mistake: Forgetting to distribute negative sign: 4y - 3y = y.

Quick Tip: Subtracted terms change sign: -(-3y) = +3y.

questions.problem: At what rate per annum will ₹4,000 earn ₹960 simple interest in 3 years?
questions.explanation:
Concept: R = (I × 100) / (P × T) = (960 × 100) / (4000 × 3) = 96000 / 12000 = 8%.

Step-by-Step Solution: R = 8%.

Common Mistake: Calculation error in zero cancellation.

Quick Tip: R = 960 / (40 × 3) = 960 / 120 = 8%.

questions.problem: What principal amount will yield ₹720 simple interest at 6% p.a. in 4 years?
A rectangular garden is 12.5 m long and 8.4 m wide. Find its area.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Area = 12.5 × 8.4 = 105.00 = 105 sq m.

Step-by-Step Solution: 12.5 × 8.4 = 105 sq m.

Common Mistake: Calculating perimeter 2(12.5+8.4) = 41.8 m.

Quick Tip: Area = Length × Width.

questions.problem: Find the average of 4.2, 3.8, 5.6, and 6.4.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Sum = 4.2 + 3.8 + 5.6 + 6.4 = 20.0. Average = 20.0 / 4 = 5.0.

Step-by-Step Solution: 20.0 / 4 = 5.0.

Common Mistake: Dividing sum by 3.

Quick Tip: Sum = 20; 20 / 4 = 5.0.

Concept: 1/2 + 1/3 = 5/6. 1/2 - 1/3 = 1/6. (5/6) ÷ (1/6) = (5/6) × (6/1) = 5.

Step-by-Step Solution: 5/6 ÷ 1/6 = 5.

Common Mistake: Inverting bracket sums.

Quick Tip: 5/6 ÷ 1/6 = 5.

questions.problem: By selling an article for ₹450, a man loses 10%. What was its Cost Price?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Loss = 10% ⇒ SP = 90% of CP. 90/100 × CP = 450 ⇒ CP = 450 × (100/90) = ₹500.

Step-by-Step Solution: CP = 450 × 100 / 90 = ₹500.

Common Mistake: Adding 10% of 450 (450 + 45 = 495).

Quick Tip: CP = SP × 100 / (100 - Loss%).

questions.problem: A shirt marked at ₹800 is sold at a discount of 15%. What is the selling price?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Discount = 15% of 800 = 120. Selling Price = 800 - 120 = ₹680.

Step-by-Step Solution: SP = 800 - 120 = ₹680.

Common Mistake: Reporting discount amount (₹120).

Quick Tip: SP = 85% of 800 = 0.85 × 800 = ₹680.

questions.problem: Express 3 hours as a percentage of a day (24 hours).
questions.explanation:
Concept: Percentage = (3 / 24) × 100% = (1/8) × 100% = 12.5%.

Step-by-Step Solution: 1/8 × 100% = 12.5%.

Common Mistake: Writing 15%.

Quick Tip: 1/8 = 12.5%.

Concept: Convert to improper: 7/2 ÷ 7/4 = (7/2) × (4/7) = 4/2 = 2.

Step-by-Step Solution: 7/2 × 4/7 = 2.

Common Mistake: Miscalculating reciprocal.

Quick Tip: 7/2 × 4/7 = 4/2 = 2.

questions.problem: If a school has 600 boys and 400 girls, what is the ratio of girls to TOTAL students?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Total students = 600 + 400 = 1000. Ratio = 400 : 1000 = 2 : 5.

Step-by-Step Solution: 400 / 1000 = 2 / 5 ⇒ 2 : 5.

Common Mistake: Writing 400 : 600 = 2 : 3 (ratio of girls to BOYS!).

Quick Tip: Read carefully: girls to TOTAL students (1000).

questions.problem: Find the total Amount to be paid back on a loan of ₹8,000 at 5% p.a. SI after 2 years.
questions.explanation:
Concept: SI = (8000 × 5 × 2) / 100 = ₹800. Amount = P + SI = 8000 + 800 = ₹8,800.

Step-by-Step Solution: Amount = 8000 + 800 = ₹8,800.

Common Mistake: Reporting SI ₹800 instead of total Amount.

Quick Tip: Amount = Principal + Interest.

questions.problem: Convert 0.005 into a percentage.
questions.explanation:
Concept: 0.005 × 100% = 0.5%.

Step-by-Step Solution: 0.005 × 100% = 0.5%.

Common Mistake: Writing 5%.

Quick Tip: Shift decimal 2 places right = 0.5%.

questions.problem: Evaluate: 0.36 ÷ 0.006.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Multiply top and bottom by 1000: 360 / 6 = 60.

Step-by-Step Solution: 360 / 6 = 60.

Common Mistake: Writing 6 or 600.

Quick Tip: 0.36 / 0.006 = 360 / 6 = 60.

questions.problem: Out of 40 students in a class, 30 passed a test. What percentage of students failed?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Failed students = 40 - 30 = 10. Failed % = (10 / 40) × 100% = 25%.

Step-by-Step Solution: (10 / 40) × 100% = 25%.

Common Mistake: Calculating passed percentage (75%).

Quick Tip: Read question carefully: percentage FAILED = (10/40) × 100% = 25%.

Concept: (7/9) × (15/14) = (7/14) × (15/9) = (1/2) × (5/3) = 5/6.

Step-by-Step Solution: (7/9) × (15/14) = 5/6.

Common Mistake: Inverting first fraction instead of second.

Quick Tip: Keep first fraction, flip second fraction.

questions.problem: A shopkeeper bought a chair for ₹1,200 and sold it for ₹1,500. Find his profit percentage.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Profit = 1500 - 1200 = ₹300. Profit % = (Profit / CP) × 100% = (300 / 1200) × 100% = 25%.

Step-by-Step Solution: Profit % = (300 / 1200) × 100% = 25%.

Common Mistake: Calculating profit % on SP (300/1500 = 20%).

Quick Tip: Profit percentage is ALWAYS calculated on Cost Price (CP)!

questions.problem: Find the Simple Interest on ₹5,000 at 8% per annum for 3 years.
questions.explanation:
Concept: I = (5000 × 8 × 3) / 100 = 50 × 24 = ₹1,200.

Step-by-Step Solution: I = ₹1,200.

Common Mistake: Reporting total Amount ₹6,200 instead of Interest.

Quick Tip: I = (P×R×T)/100 = 50×24 = ₹1,200.

questions.problem: If 25% of a number is 40, find the number.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Let number be x. 25/100 × x = 40 ⇒ 1/4 x = 40 ⇒ x = 160.

Step-by-Step Solution: 1/4 x = 40 ⇒ x = 160.

Common Mistake: Calculating 25% of 40 (10).

Quick Tip: Number = 40 × 4 = 160.

questions.problem: Solve: 2x + 5 = 15.
questions.explanation:
Concept: 2x = 10 ⇒ x = 5.

Step-by-Step Solution: 2x = 10 ⇒ x = 5.

Common Mistake: Writing 10.

Quick Tip: Subtract 5 first, then divide by 2.

questions.problem: Convert ratio 3 : 5 into percentage of total.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Total parts = 3 + 5 = 8. First part % = (3/8) × 100% = 37.5%. Second part % = (5/8) × 100% = 62.5%.

Step-by-Step Solution: 3/8 = 37.5%, 5/8 = 62.5%.

Common Mistake: Calculating 3/5 × 100% = 60%.

Quick Tip: Total parts = 3 + 5 = 8.

questions.problem: Write expression: "7 subtracted from 3 times n".
questions.explanation:
Concept: 3 times n = 3n. Subtract 7 = 3n - 7.

Step-by-Step Solution: 3n - 7.

Common Mistake: Writing 7 - 3n.

Quick Tip: "Subtracted from 3n" means 3n comes first.

questions.problem: Evaluate x^2 - y^2 when x = 5 and y = 3.
questions.explanation:
Concept: 5^2 - 3^2 = 25 - 9 = 16.

Step-by-Step Solution: 25 - 9 = 16.

Common Mistake: Writing (5 - 3)^2 = 4.

Quick Tip: 5^2 = 25, 3^2 = 9; 25 - 9 = 16.

questions.problem: Find x if 3x - 4 = x + 6.
questions.explanation:
Concept: 3x - x = 6 + 4 ⇒ 2x = 10 ⇒ x = 5.

Step-by-Step Solution: 2x = 10 ⇒ x = 5.

Common Mistake: Writing 2.

Quick Tip: 3x - x = 2x; 6 + 4 = 10.

questions.problem: Add: (2x + 3y) and (x - y).
questions.explanation:
Concept: (2x + x) + (3y - y) = 3x + 2y.

Step-by-Step Solution: 3x + 2y.

Common Mistake: Adding 3y + (-y) as 4y.

Quick Tip: 3y - y = 2y.

questions.problem: Solve: 5m + 7 = 22.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Step 1: 5m = 22 - 7 = 15. Step 2: m = 15 / 5 = 3.

Step-by-Step Solution: 5m = 15 ⇒ m = 3.

Common Mistake: Dividing 22 by 5 before subtracting 7.

Quick Tip: Subtract constant term first, then divide by coefficient.

Concept: Group like terms: (3x^2 + 2x^2) + (-5x + 7x) + (2 - 6) = 5x^2 + 2x - 4.

Step-by-Step Solution: 5x^2 + 2x - 4.

Common Mistake: Adding coefficients of unlike terms.

Quick Tip: Combine x^2 terms, x terms, and constant terms separately.

questions.problem: Find the value of 3a^2 - 2ab + b^2 when a = 2 and b = -1.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Substitute a = 2, b = -1: 3(2)^2 - 2(2)(-1) + (-1)^2 = 3(4) - (-4) + 1 = 12 + 4 + 1 = 17.

Step-by-Step Solution: 12 + 4 + 1 = 17.

Common Mistake: Writing -2(2)(-1) = -4 (forgetting double negative becomes +4!).

Quick Tip: -2(2)(-1) = +4.

Concept: Method 1: x - 2 = 15 / 3 = 5 ⇒ x = 5 + 2 = 7.

Step-by-Step Solution: x - 2 = 5 ⇒ x = 7.

Common Mistake: Writing 3(x - 2) = 3x - 2 = 15.

Quick Tip: Divide by 3 first: x - 2 = 5 ⇒ x = 7.

questions.problem: Find the reciprocal of 7/3.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Reciprocal of p/q is q/p.

Step-by-Step Solution: Reciprocal of 7/3 is 3/7.

Common Mistake: Writing -3/7.

Quick Tip: Flip fraction.

questions.problem: What is the value of (-3) × 0 × (-7)?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Multiplication by 0 results in 0.

Step-by-Step Solution: (-3) × 0 × (-7) = 0.

Common Mistake: Multiplying -3 × -7 = 21.

Quick Tip: Any product containing 0 is 0.

questions.problem: Convert 7.8 × 10^3 into standard numeral.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Multiply 7.8 by 1,000.

Step-by-Step Solution: 7.8 × 1,000 = 7,800.

Common Mistake: Writing 78,000.

Quick Tip: Move decimal 3 places right.

questions.problem: Subtract: 4/5 - 1/2.
questions.explanation:
Concept: LCM(5, 2) = 10. 8/10 - 5/10 = 3/10.

Step-by-Step Solution: 8/10 - 5/10 = 3/10.

Common Mistake: Subtracting top and bottom (3/3).

Quick Tip: Common denominator 10.

questions.problem: Simplify: (4^2)^3.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Power law: (a^m)^n = a^(m×n).

Step-by-Step Solution: 4^(2×3) = 4^6.

Common Mistake: Adding 2 + 3 = 5.

Quick Tip: Multiply exponents for power of power.

questions.problem: A car travels 43.2 km on 2.4 liters of petrol. How far will it travel on 1 liter of petrol?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Distance per liter = 43.2 / 2.4 = 432 / 24 = 18 km.

Step-by-Step Solution: 432 / 24 = 18 km.

Common Mistake: Calculation error.

Quick Tip: 432 / 24 = 18 km/L.

questions.problem: A student scored 45 out of 50 in Math. What is his percentage score?
questions.explanation:
Concept: (45 / 50) × 100% = 45 × 2 = 90%.

Step-by-Step Solution: 45 × 2 = 90%.

Common Mistake: Writing 85%.

Quick Tip: 45/50 = 90/100 = 90%.

questions.problem: If ratio of boys to girls is 3 : 2 and there are 15 boys, how many girls are there?
questions.explanation:
Concept: 3 parts = 15 ⇒ 1 part = 5. Girls = 2 parts = 2 × 5 = 10.

Step-by-Step Solution: 2 × 5 = 10.

Common Mistake: Calculating 15 × 2 / 3 = 10.

Quick Tip: 15 / 3 = 5; 5 × 2 = 10.

questions.problem: A bicycle bought for ₹2,500 is sold at a loss of 12%. Find the selling price.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Loss = 12% of 2500 = 300. Selling Price = 2500 - 300 = ₹2,200.

Step-by-Step Solution: SP = 2500 - 300 = ₹2,200.

Common Mistake: Reporting loss amount ₹300.

Quick Tip: SP = 88% of 2500 = 0.88 × 2500 = ₹2,200.

questions.problem: Simplify: 2 1/3 × 1 2/7.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Convert to improper fractions: 7/3 × 9/7 = (7 × 9)/(3 × 7) = 9/3 = 3.

Step-by-Step Solution: 7/3 × 9/7 = 9/3 = 3.

Common Mistake: Multiplying whole numbers and fractions separately.

Quick Tip: Convert mixed fractions to improper fractions first!

questions.problem: The population of a city increased from 50,000 to 55,000. Find the percentage increase.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Increase = 55,000 - 50,000 = 5,000. Percentage Increase = (5000 / 50000) × 100% = 10%.

Step-by-Step Solution: (5000 / 50000) × 100% = 10%.

Common Mistake: Calculating percentage on new population (5000/55000).

Quick Tip: Percentage change is always based on ORIGINAL value.

questions.problem: If 3.5 kg of rice costs ₹140, what is the cost of 5 kg of rice?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Cost per kg = 140 / 3.5 = ₹40. Cost of 5 kg = 40 × 5 = ₹200.

Step-by-Step Solution: 40 × 5 = ₹200.

Common Mistake: Decimal division error.

Quick Tip: 140 / 3.5 = 40; 40 × 5 = 200.

questions.problem: Find the area of a right-angled triangle with legs of lengths 9 cm and 12 cm.
questions.explanation:
Concept: In a right triangle, legs serve as base and height. Area = 1/2 × 9 × 12 = 54 sq cm.

Step-by-Step Solution: 1/2 × 9 × 12 = 54 sq cm.

Common Mistake: Forgetting 1/2 factor (108).

Quick Tip: Area = 1/2 × leg1 × leg2.

questions.problem: Find the measure of an angle which is equal to its complement.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Let angle = x. x + x = 90° ⇒ 2x = 90° ⇒ x = 45°.

Step-by-Step Solution: x = 45°.

Common Mistake: Choosing 90°.

Quick Tip: 45° + 45° = 90°.

questions.problem: Find the measure of an angle which is equal to its supplement.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Let angle = x. x + x = 180° ⇒ 2x = 180° ⇒ x = 90°.

Step-by-Step Solution: x = 90°.

Common Mistake: Choosing 45°.

Quick Tip: 90° + 90° = 180°.

questions.problem: Euler's formula for 3D polyhedra relates Faces (F), Vertices (V), and Edges (E) as:
questions.explanation:
Concept: Euler's formula: F + V - E = 2.

Step-by-Step Solution: F + V - E = 2.

Common Mistake: Confusing signs.

Quick Tip: Faces + Vertices - Edges = 2.

questions.problem: Find the area of a triangle with base 14 cm and height 8 cm.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Area = 1/2 × Base × Height.

Step-by-Step Solution: 1/2 × 14 × 8 = 7 × 8 = 56 sq cm.

Common Mistake: Forgetting 1/2 factor (112 sq cm).

Quick Tip: Triangle area = 1/2 × base × height.

questions.problem: Find the area of a parallelogram with base 12 cm and height 7 cm.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Area = Base × Height.

Step-by-Step Solution: 12 × 7 = 84 sq cm.

Common Mistake: Dividing by 2 (42 sq cm, confusing with triangle!).

Quick Tip: Parallelogram area = b × h = 12 × 7 = 84.

questions.problem: If a wheel of radius 35 cm rotates 100 times, what total distance does it cover? (Take π = 22/7)
questions.explanation:
Concept: Circumference = 2 × (22/7) × 35 = 220 cm. Distance in 100 turns = 220 × 100 = 22,000 cm = 220 m.

Step-by-Step Solution: 22,000 cm = 220 meters.

Common Mistake: Forgetting to convert cm to meters.

Quick Tip: 220 cm × 100 = 22,000 cm = 220 m.

questions.problem: Find the area of a square whose perimeter is 36 cm.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Side = 36 / 4 = 9 cm. Area = 9 × 9 = 81 sq cm.

Step-by-Step Solution: 9 × 9 = 81 sq cm.

Common Mistake: Using 36 directly as side length.

Quick Tip: Divide perimeter by 4 to get side, then square side.

questions.problem: What is the range of the dataset: 12, 5, 25, 18, 9?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Range = Maximum value - Minimum value.

Step-by-Step Solution: 25 - 5 = 20.

Common Mistake: Reporting maximum value 25.

Quick Tip: Range = Max - Min = 25 - 5 = 20.

Concept: Absolute value |x| is always non-negative.

Step-by-Step Solution: 18 + 12 - 5 = 30 - 5 = 25.

Common Mistake: Writing -18 + 12 - (-5) = -1.

Quick Tip: Absolute value removes negative sign.

questions.problem: What is the sum of -5/12 and -7/12?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Like denominators: (-5 + -7)/12 = -12/12 = -1.

Step-by-Step Solution: (-5 - 7)/12 = -12/12 = -1.

Common Mistake: Adding denominators (-12/24).

Quick Tip: -12/12 = -1.

questions.problem: Find the value of x if (-4)^5 × (-4)^x = (-4)^11.
questions.explanation:
Concept: When bases are same, a^m × a^n = a^(m+n). Equate powers.

Step-by-Step Solution: 5 + x = 11 ⇒ x = 11 - 5 = 6.

Common Mistake: Multiplying 5 × x = 11.

Quick Tip: 5 + x = 11 ⇒ x = 6.

questions.problem: Find the multiplicative inverse of 2^-3.
questions.explanation:
Concept: 2^-3 = 1 / 2^3 = 1/8. Reciprocal of 1/8 is 8.

Step-by-Step Solution: 1 / (1/8) = 8 (or 2^3 = 8).

Common Mistake: Writing 1/8 (that is the value of 2^-3, not its inverse).

Quick Tip: Multiplicative inverse of 2^-n is 2^n.

Concept: (-1)^even = 1, (-1)^odd = -1.

Step-by-Step Solution: 1 + (-1) = 0.

Common Mistake: Writing 2 or -2.

Quick Tip: 1 - 1 = 0.

questions.problem: Which property is illustrated by: (-7) × [5 + (-3)] = (-7) × 5 + (-7) × (-3)?
questions.explanation:
Concept: a × (b + c) = a × b + a × c is Distributive Property of Multiplication over Addition.

Step-by-Step Solution: Distributive Property.

Common Mistake: Confusing with Associative property.

Quick Tip: Multiplication distributed over addition = Distributive Property.

questions.problem: If 3/x = -15/20, find x.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Cross multiply: 3 × 20 = -15 × x ⇒ 60 = -15x ⇒ x = 60 / -15 = -4.

Step-by-Step Solution: x = (3 × 20) / -15 = 60 / -15 = -4.

Common Mistake: Writing +4.

Quick Tip: Positive / Negative = Negative.

questions.problem: Express 4^3 as a power with base 2.
questions.explanation:
Concept: 4 = 2^2. So 4^3 = (2^2)^3 = 2^6.

Step-by-Step Solution: (2^2)^3 = 2^6.

Common Mistake: Writing 2^5.

Quick Tip: 4 = 2^2; (2^2)^3 = 2^(2×3) = 2^6.

questions.problem: Find the ratio of area of a square of side 4 cm to area of square of side 8 cm.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Area 1 = 16. Area 2 = 64. Ratio = 16 : 64 = 1 : 4.

Step-by-Step Solution: 16 / 64 = 1 / 4 ⇒ 1 : 4.

Common Mistake: Writing 1 : 2 (side ratio instead of area ratio!).

Quick Tip: Area ratio = (side1/side2)^2 = (1/2)^2 = 1/4.

questions.problem: Two supplementary angles are in the ratio 4 : 5. Find the smaller angle.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Total parts = 9. 1 part = 180° / 9 = 20°. Smaller angle = 4 × 20° = 80°.

Step-by-Step Solution: 4 × 20° = 80°.

Common Mistake: Using 90° sum.

Quick Tip: Supplementary sum = 180°.

questions.problem: Two complementary angles are in the ratio 2 : 3. Find the larger angle.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Total parts = 2 + 3 = 5. 1 part = 90° / 5 = 18°. Larger angle = 3 × 18° = 54°.

Step-by-Step Solution: 3 × 18° = 54°.

Common Mistake: Using 180° instead of 90°.

Quick Tip: Complementary sum = 90°.

questions.problem: If parallel lines are cut by a transversal, and one interior angle on one side is 75°, what is the other interior angle on the SAME side?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Interior angles on the same side of transversal are SUPPLEMENTARY (add up to 180°).

Step-by-Step Solution: 180° - 75° = 105°.

Common Mistake: Writing 75° (thinking they are equal).

Quick Tip: Consecutive interior angles add up to 180°.

questions.problem: If parallel lines l and m are cut by a transversal, and one interior angle is 65°, what is the corresponding angle?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Corresponding angles formed by a transversal intersecting parallel lines are EQUAL.

Step-by-Step Solution: Corresponding angle = 65°.

Common Mistake: Writing 115° (that is co-interior/consecutive interior angle!).

Quick Tip: Corresponding angles are EQUAL.

questions.problem: What is the cross-section obtained when a cylinder is cut HORIZONTALLY (parallel to base)?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Cutting a cylinder parallel to its base gives a circular cross-section.

Step-by-Step Solution: Circle.

Common Mistake: Choosing rectangle (which is vertical cut!).

Quick Tip: Horizontal cut of cylinder = Circle.

questions.problem: What is the cross-section obtained when a cylinder is cut VERTICALLY (perpendicular to base)?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Cutting a cylinder vertically through its center gives a rectangular cross-section.

Step-by-Step Solution: Rectangle.

Common Mistake: Choosing circle.

Quick Tip: Vertical cut of cylinder = Rectangle.

questions.problem: In triangle ABC, angle A = x, angle B = 2x, angle C = 3x. Find angle C.
questions.explanation:
Concept: x + 2x + 3x = 180° ⇒ 6x = 180° ⇒ x = 30°. Angle C = 3x = 90°.

Step-by-Step Solution: 3 × 30° = 90°.

Common Mistake: Reporting x = 30° instead of angle C.

Quick Tip: x = 30°, B = 60°, C = 90°.

questions.problem: Find the area of a rhombus whose diagonals are 10 cm and 12 cm.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Area of rhombus = 1/2 × d1 × d2.

Step-by-Step Solution: 1/2 × 10 × 12 = 60 sq cm.

Common Mistake: Multiplying 10 × 12 = 120.

Quick Tip: Rhombus area = 1/2 × d1 × d2.

questions.problem: How many edges does a square pyramid have?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Square base has 4 edges + 4 side edges = 8 edges.

Step-by-Step Solution: 4 + 4 = 8 edges.

Common Mistake: Confusing edges (8) with faces (5).

Quick Tip: Square pyramid: F=5, V=5, E=8.

questions.problem: Find the diameter of a circle whose circumference is 44 cm (Take π = 22/7).
questions.explanation:
Concept: C = π × d ⇒ 44 = (22/7) × d ⇒ d = 44 × (7/22) = 14 cm.

Step-by-Step Solution: d = 14 cm.

Common Mistake: Reporting radius 7 cm instead of diameter.

Quick Tip: d = (C × 7) / 22 = (44 × 7) / 22 = 14 cm.

questions.problem: A polyhedron has 6 faces and 8 vertices. How many edges does it have?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Using Euler's formula F + V - E = 2: 6 + 8 - E = 2 ⇒ 14 - E = 2 ⇒ E = 12.

Step-by-Step Solution: E = 12 edges.

Common Mistake: Adding 6 + 8 = 14.

Quick Tip: E = F + V - 2 = 6 + 8 - 2 = 12.

questions.problem: Find the height of a parallelogram if its area is 48 sq cm and base is 8 cm.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Height = Area / Base = 48 / 8 = 6 cm.

Step-by-Step Solution: 48 / 8 = 6 cm.

Common Mistake: Dividing by 2.

Quick Tip: Height = Area / Base.

questions.problem: A 13 m long ladder reaches a window 12 m high on a wall. How far is the foot of the ladder from the wall?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Ladder forms hypotenuse c = 13. Height a = 12. Foot distance b = sqrt(13^2 - 12^2) = sqrt(169 - 144) = sqrt(25) = 5 m.

Step-by-Step Solution: b = sqrt(169 - 144) = 5 m.

Common Mistake: Adding 13 + 12 = 25 m.

Quick Tip: Ladder = Hypotenuse. b^2 = c^2 - a^2.

questions.problem: Can a triangle have sides of lengths 4 cm, 5 cm, and 10 cm?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Triangle Inequality Theorem: Sum of lengths of any two sides MUST be greater than the third side.

Step-by-Step Solution: 4 + 5 = 9, which is NOT greater than 10. So no such triangle exists.

Common Mistake: Saying Yes.

Quick Tip: Sum of two smaller sides MUST be strictly greater than largest side.
choices: Yes, because all lengths are positive

questions.problem: An exterior angle of a triangle is 110° and one interior opposite angle is 45°. Find the other interior opposite angle.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Exterior angle property: Exterior angle = Sum of interior opposite angles.

Step-by-Step Solution: 110° = 45° + x ⇒ x = 110° - 45° = 65°.

Common Mistake: Adding 110° + 45° = 155°.

Quick Tip: Exterior angle = Angle1 + Angle2.

questions.problem: In a right-angled triangle, base = 6 cm and height = 8 cm. Find the length of the hypotenuse.
questions.explanation:
Concept: c^2 = a^2 + b^2 = 6^2 + 8^2 = 36 + 64 = 100. c = sqrt(100) = 10 cm.

Step-by-Step Solution: c = sqrt(36 + 64) = sqrt(100) = 10 cm.

Common Mistake: Adding 6 + 8 = 14 cm.

Quick Tip: Pythagorean triplet (6, 8, 10).

questions.problem: Find the area of a circle of radius 7 cm (Take π = 22/7).
questions.explanation:
Concept: Area A = π × r^2.

Step-by-Step Solution: (22/7) × 7 × 7 = 22 × 7 = 154 sq sq cm.

Common Mistake: Calculating circumference (44 cm).

Quick Tip: A = (22/7) × 7 × 7 = 154 sq cm.

questions.problem: Find SP if CP = ₹800 and Profit = 20%.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Profit = 20% of 800 = 160. SP = 800 + 160 = ₹960.

Step-by-Step Solution: 800 + 160 = ₹960.

Common Mistake: Adding 20 directly (820).

Quick Tip: 800 × 1.2 = 960.

Concept: 81 / 90 = 0.9.

Step-by-Step Solution: 0.81 / 0.9 = 0.9.

Common Mistake: Writing 0.09.

Quick Tip: 0.81 / 0.9 = 8.1 / 9 = 0.9.

questions.problem: Find SI on ₹2,000 at 10% p.a. for 2 years.
questions.explanation:
Concept: I = (2000 × 10 × 2)/100 = ₹400.

Step-by-Step Solution: I = ₹400.

Common Mistake: Writing ₹2400 (Amount).

Quick Tip: 20 × 20 = 400.

questions.problem: Find the value of x if two angles (3x + 10)° and (2x + 20)° form a linear pair.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Linear pair angles add up to 180°.

Step-by-Step Solution: (3x + 10) + (2x + 20) = 180 ⇒ 5x + 30 = 180 ⇒ 5x = 150 ⇒ x = 30.

Common Mistake: Setting them equal to 90°.

Quick Tip: Linear pair sum = 180°.

questions.problem: Two angles of a triangle are 50° and 70°. Find the third angle.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Angle sum property: Third angle = 180° - (50° + 70°) = 180° - 120° = 60°.

Step-by-Step Solution: 180° - 120° = 60°.

Common Mistake: Subtracting from 90°.

Quick Tip: 180° - (50 + 70) = 60°.

questions.problem: In a right triangle, one acute angle is 38°. What is the measure of the other acute angle?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Sum of acute angles in right triangle = 90°. Other angle = 90° - 38° = 52°.

Step-by-Step Solution: 90° - 38° = 52°.

Common Mistake: Subtracting from 180° (giving 142°).

Quick Tip: 90° - 38° = 52°.

questions.problem: Find the perimeter of a semicircle of radius 7 cm including its diameter (Take π = 22/7).
questions.explanation:
Concept: Perimeter = Curved arc + Diameter = π r + 2r = (22/7 × 7) + 14 = 22 + 14 = 36 cm.

Step-by-Step Solution: 22 + 14 = 36 cm.

Common Mistake: Forgetting to add diameter (22 cm).

Quick Tip: Semicircle perimeter = π r + 2r.

questions.problem: Find the base of a triangle whose area is 36 sq cm and height is 6 cm.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Area = 1/2 × b × h ⇒ 36 = 1/2 × b × 6 ⇒ 36 = 3b ⇒ b = 12 cm.

Step-by-Step Solution: b = (2 × 36) / 6 = 12 cm.

Common Mistake: Dividing 36 by 6 without multiplying by 2 (6 cm).

Quick Tip: Base = (2 × Area) / Height.

questions.problem: Find the circumference of a circle of radius 14 cm (Take π = 22/7).
questions.explanation:
Concept: Circumference C = 2 × π × r.

Step-by-Step Solution: 2 × (22/7) × 14 = 2 × 22 × 2 = 88 cm.

Common Mistake: Calculating area (616 sq cm) instead of circumference.

Quick Tip: C = 2 × (22/7) × 14 = 88 cm.

questions.problem: How many capital letters in the English alphabet (A to Z) have rotational symmetry of order 2?
questions.correct_answer: 7 letters (H, I, N, O, S, X, Z)
questions.explanation:
Concept: Letters H, I, N, O, S, X, Z look identical after a 180° half-turn.

Step-by-Step Solution: H, I, N, O, S, X, Z (7 letters).

Common Mistake: Forgetting N, S, or Z (which have rotational symmetry but NO vertical line symmetry!).

Quick Tip: N, S, Z look identical when turned 180° upside down.
choices: 7 letters (H, I, N, O, S, X, Z)

questions.problem: The median of observations 11, 12, 14, (x + 2), (x + 4), 20, 22, 25 arranged in ascending order is 17. Find x.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Dataset has 8 observations (even). Middle two are (x + 2) and (x + 4). Median = [(x + 2) + (x + 4)] / 2 = (2x + 6) / 2 = x + 3 = 17 ⇒ x = 14.

Step-by-Step Solution: x + 3 = 17 ⇒ x = 14.

Common Mistake: Writing x + 2 = 17.

Quick Tip: Average of (x+2) and (x+4) is (x+3) = 17 ⇒ x = 14.

questions.problem: In a box of 50 bulbs, 5 are defective. What is the probability of picking a NON-DEFECTIVE bulb?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Non-defective = 50 - 5 = 45. Probability = 45 / 50 = 9/10.

Step-by-Step Solution: 45 / 50 = 9/10.

Common Mistake: Calculating defective probability (5/50 = 1/10).

Quick Tip: Read NON-DEFECTIVE: 45 / 50 = 9/10.

questions.problem: What is the sum of the mean, median, and mode of the dataset: 3, 5, 5, 5, 7, 8, 9, 14?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Calculate mean, median, and mode individually, then add them.

Step-by-Step Solution: Sum = 56 ⇒ Mean = 56 / 8 = 7. Middle values = 5 and 7 ⇒ Median = (5 + 7)/2 = 6. Mode = 5. Total = 7 + 6 + 5 = 18.

Common Mistake: Calculating median as 5.

Quick Tip: Mean = 7, Median = 6, Mode = 5 ⇒ 7 + 6 + 5 = 18.

Concept: LCM(5, 2) = 10. Multiply through by 10: 2(3x - 1) - 5(x + 2) = 10 ⇒ 6x - 2 - 5x - 10 = 10 ⇒ x - 12 = 10 ⇒ x = 22... Wait: 6x - 5x = x; -2 - 10 = -12; x - 12 = 10 ⇒ x = 22.

Step-by-Step Solution: 2(3x - 1) - 5(x + 2) = 10 ⇒ 6x - 2 - 5x - 10 = 10 ⇒ x - 12 = 10 ⇒ x = 22.

Common Mistake: Distributing -5 to +2 as +10 instead of -10.

Quick Tip: Multiply entire equation by LCM 10.

questions.problem: Two equal sides of an isosceles triangle are each (3x - 1) cm and the third side is (2x + 5) cm. If the perimeter is 43 cm, find x.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Sum of all 3 sides equals perimeter.

Step-by-Step Solution: 8x + 3 = 43 ⇒ 8x = 40 ⇒ x = 5.

Common Mistake: Adding only 2 sides: (3x - 1) + (2x + 5).

Quick Tip: 2(3x - 1) + (2x + 5) = 43.

questions.problem: Simplify: 3(2a - b) - 2(a - 3b) - 5(a + b).
questions.explanation:
Concept: Expand: 6a - 3b - 2a + 6b - 5a - 5b. Group like terms: (6 - 2 - 5)a + (-3 + 6 - 5)b = -1a - 2b... wait: -3 + 6 - 5 = -2b. Result = -a - 2b.

Step-by-Step Solution: 6a - 3b - 2a + 6b - 5a - 5b = -a - 2b.

Common Mistake: Sign errors during bracket expansion.

Quick Tip: -2(-3b) = +6b; -5(+b) = -5b.

questions.problem: A grandmother is 6 times as old as her granddaughter. In 10 years, she will be 4 times as old. Find the present age of the granddaughter.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Let granddaughter's present age = x. Grandmother = 6x. In 10 yrs: 6x + 10 = 4(x + 10) ⇒ 6x + 10 = 4x + 40 ⇒ 2x = 30 ⇒ x = 15 years.

Step-by-Step Solution: 2x = 30 ⇒ x = 15.

Common Mistake: Writing 6x + 10 = 4x + 10 (forgetting to add 10 to granddaughter's age!).

Quick Tip: Add 10 to BOTH ages in 10 years.

Concept: Nested fraction: 1 + 1/2 = 3/2. 1 / (3/2) = 2/3. 1 + 2/3 = 5/3. 1 / (5/3) = 3/5.

Step-by-Step Solution: 1 / (5/3) = 3/5.

Common Mistake: Inverting incorrectly.

Quick Tip: Work from innermost denominator outward.

questions.problem: What is the unit digit of 3^40?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Cyclicity of powers of 3: 3^1=3, 3^2=9, 3^3=27(7), 3^4=81(1). Cycle repeats every 4 powers. Since 40 is divisible by 4, unit digit is 1.

Step-by-Step Solution: 40 mod 4 = 0 ⇒ 4th position in cycle (3, 9, 7, 1) ⇒ 1.

Common Mistake: Multiplying 3 × 40 = 120.

Quick Tip: Powers of 3 end in 3, 9, 7, 1. Multiples of 4 power end in 1.

questions.problem: Find the value of (2^3 × 2^4) / 2^5.
questions.explanation:
Concept: 2^(3+4) / 2^5 = 2^7 / 2^5 = 2^(7-5) = 2^2 = 4.

Step-by-Step Solution: 2^2 = 4.

Common Mistake: Calculation error.

Quick Tip: 2^(7-5) = 2^2 = 4.

questions.problem: A sum of money doubles itself in 8 years at Simple Interest. What is the rate of interest per annum?
questions.explanation:
Concept: If Principal = P, Amount = 2P ⇒ Interest I = P. I = (P × R × T)/100 ⇒ P = (P × R × 8)/100 ⇒ R = 100 / 8 = 12.5%.

Step-by-Step Solution: R = 100 / 8 = 12.5%.

Common Mistake: Writing 10%.

Quick Tip: Doubling rule for SI: R × T = 100 ⇒ R = 100 / T.

questions.problem: Find the average of integers: -10, -5, 0, 5, 10.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Sum = -10 + -5 + 0 + 5 + 10 = 0. Average = 0 / 5 = 0.

Step-by-Step Solution: 0 / 5 = 0.

Common Mistake: Summing absolute values.

Quick Tip: Symmetric integers around 0 have average 0.

questions.problem: Express 0.000056 in scientific notation.
questions.explanation:
Concept: 5.6 × 10^-5.

Step-by-Step Solution: Move decimal 5 places right.

Common Mistake: Writing 10^-4.

Quick Tip: 5.6 × 10^-5.

Concept: (-1)^101 = -1. (-1)^102 = 1. -1 + 1 = 0.

Step-by-Step Solution: -1 + 1 = 0.

Common Mistake: Writing -2.

Quick Tip: Odd power (-1) + Even power (+1) = 0.

questions.problem: Solve for n: 5^n = 625.
questions.explanation:
Concept: 5^1=5, 5^2=25, 5^3=125, 5^4=625 ⇒ n = 4.

Step-by-Step Solution: 5^4 = 625.

Common Mistake: Writing 3.

Quick Tip: 5 × 5 × 5 × 5 = 625.

questions.problem: If 12 men can complete a work in 20 days, how many days will 15 men take to complete the SAME work?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Inverse proportion: Men × Days = Constant. 12 × 20 = 15 × D ⇒ 240 = 15D ⇒ D = 16 days.

Step-by-Step Solution: D = 240 / 15 = 16 days.

Common Mistake: Using direct proportion: (15 × 20) / 12 = 25 days.

Quick Tip: More men means FEWER days! Inverse variation: M1×D1 = M2×D2.

questions.problem: A man bought 2 fans for ₹1,200 each. He sold one at a profit of 10% and the other at a loss of 10%. What is his overall profit or loss percentage?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Since CP of both fans is SAME (₹1,200): Profit on 1st = ₹120, Loss on 2nd = ₹120. Net profit/loss = 0.

Step-by-Step Solution: Net Profit/Loss = +120 - 120 = 0.

Common Mistake: Conflating with equal SELLING price case (which gives 1% loss). When CPs are equal, net result is 0%!

Quick Tip: Equal CPs with equal profit% and loss% ALWAYS result in NO profit, NO loss.

questions.problem: A vessel contains 3.75 liters of milk. If 0.85 liters is used for coffee and 1.4 liters for dessert, how much milk is left?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Used = 0.85 + 1.40 = 2.25 L. Left = 3.75 - 2.25 = 1.50 = 1.5 liters.

Step-by-Step Solution: 3.75 - 2.25 = 1.5 L.

Common Mistake: Aligning 1.4 as 0.14.

Quick Tip: 1.4 = 1.40; 0.85 + 1.40 = 2.25 L.

questions.problem: A drum contains 200 liters of oil. 15% of oil leaks out. Out of the remaining oil, 40% is sold. How many liters of oil are LEFT in the drum?
questions.explanation:
Concept: After leak: 200 - 15% of 200 = 200 - 30 = 170 L. Remaining after sale = 170 - 40% of 170 = 170 - 68 = 102 L. (Or 60% of 170 = 102 L).

Step-by-Step Solution: 170 × 0.60 = 102 L.

Common Mistake: Subtracting 15% + 40% = 55% from 200 (giving 90 L).

Quick Tip: Apply second percentage on REMAINING amount (170 L), not initial!

questions.problem: In an examination, 35% of total students failed and 455 passed. Find the total number of students who appeared for the exam.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Passed % = 100% - 35% = 65%. 65/100 × Total = 455 ⇒ Total = (455 × 100) / 65 = 7 × 100 = 700.

Step-by-Step Solution: Total = 455 / 0.65 = 700 students.

Common Mistake: Dividing 455 by 35.

Quick Tip: Passed % is 65%. Total = 455 / 0.65 = 700.

questions.problem: A reduction of 20% in the price of sugar enables a purchaser to obtain 3 kg more for ₹360. Find the reduced price per kg.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Money saved by 20% reduction = 20% of 360 = ₹72. This ₹72 buys 3 kg extra. Reduced price per kg = 72 / 3 = ₹24.

Step-by-Step Solution: Reduced price = (20% of 360) / 3 = 72 / 3 = ₹24/kg.

Common Mistake: Calculating original price (₹30) instead of reduced price.

Quick Tip: Reduced price per kg = (Saved money) / (Extra kg) = 72 / 3 = ₹24.

questions.problem: What principal will amount to ₹9,920 in 3 years at 8% per annum Simple Interest?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Amount = P + (P × R × T)/100 = P[1 + (8 × 3)/100] = P[1 + 24/100] = 1.24 P. 1.24 P = 9920 ⇒ P = 9920 / 1.24 = ₹8,000.

Step-by-Step Solution: P = 9920 / 1.24 = ₹8,000.

Common Mistake: Calculating 24% of 9920 and subtracting it.

Quick Tip: A = P(1 + RT/100) ⇒ P = A / (1 + RT/100).

questions.problem: By selling a watch for ₹1,440, a shopkeeper loses 10%. At what price should he sell it to GAIN 10%?
questions.explanation:
Concept: CP = 1440 × (100 / 90) = ₹1,600. To gain 10%: SP = 1600 × 1.10 = ₹1,760.

Step-by-Step Solution: CP = ₹1,600. Target SP = 1600 × 1.1 = ₹1,760.

Common Mistake: Adding 20% to 1440 directly.

Quick Tip: Find CP first (1600), then apply 10% gain (1760).

questions.problem: Divide ₹1,400 among A, B, and C in the ratio 2 : 3 : 5. Find C's share.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Total parts = 2 + 3 + 5 = 10. 1 part = 1400 / 10 = ₹140. C's share = 5 × 140 = ₹700.

Step-by-Step Solution: 5 × 140 = ₹700.

Common Mistake: Dividing by 3.

Quick Tip: C's share = (5/10) × 1400 = ₹700.

Concept: Numerator = 0.04 + 0.02 = 0.06. Division = 0.06 ÷ 0.06 = 1.

Step-by-Step Solution: 0.06 / 0.06 = 1.

Common Mistake: 0.2 × 0.2 = 0.4 (forgetting 2 decimal places = 0.04).

Quick Tip: 0.2 × 0.2 = 0.04.

questions.problem: If the interest on a certain sum for 2 years at 5% p.a. is ₹400, what will be the interest on TWICE the sum for 3 years at the SAME rate?
questions.explanation:
Concept: P = (400 × 100)/(5 × 2) = ₹4,000. New P = ₹8,000. New Interest = (8000 × 5 × 3)/100 = ₹1,200.

Step-by-Step Solution: New I = (8000 × 5 × 3)/100 = ₹1,200.

Common Mistake: Doubling interest to 800 without adjusting for 3 years.

Quick Tip: SI is proportional to P and T: 400 × 2 (double P) × (3/2) (time ratio) = 1,200.

Concept: x - 3 = 4 ⇒ x = 7.

Step-by-Step Solution: x = 7.

Common Mistake: Writing 4.

Quick Tip: Divide by 5 first: x - 3 = 4 ⇒ x = 7.

questions.problem: Solve: x/2 + x/3 = 10.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Common denominator 6: (3x + 2x)/6 = 10 ⇒ 5x/6 = 10 ⇒ 5x = 60 ⇒ x = 12.

Step-by-Step Solution: 5x = 60 ⇒ x = 12.

Common Mistake: Writing 5x/5 = 10.

Quick Tip: LCM(2,3) = 6; 5x/6 = 10 ⇒ x = 12.

questions.problem: Simplify: (x + y)^2 - (x^2 + y^2).
questions.explanation:
Concept: (x^2 + 2xy + y^2) - (x^2 + y^2) = 2xy.

Step-by-Step Solution: 2xy.

Common Mistake: Writing 0.

Quick Tip: (x + y)^2 = x^2 + 2xy + y^2.

questions.problem: The length of a rectangle is twice its breadth. If perimeter is 36 cm, find length.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Breadth = b, Length = 2b. Perimeter = 2(2b + b) = 6b = 36 ⇒ b = 6 cm. Length = 12 cm.

Step-by-Step Solution: Length = 2 × 6 = 12 cm.

Common Mistake: Reporting breadth (6 cm).

Quick Tip: Breadth = 6, Length = 12 cm.

questions.problem: If 2x + 3 = 11, find the value of 3x - 1.
questions.explanation:
Concept: 2x = 8 ⇒ x = 4. 3(4) - 1 = 12 - 1 = 11.

Step-by-Step Solution: x = 4. 3(4) - 1 = 11.

Common Mistake: Writing x = 4 as final answer.

Quick Tip: Find x first, then substitute into 3x - 1.

questions.problem: The length of a rectangle is 4 cm more than twice its breadth. If perimeter is 56 cm, find the area of the rectangle.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Let breadth = b. Length = 2b + 4. Perimeter = 2(2b + 4 + b) = 2(3b + 4) = 6b + 8 = 56 ⇒ 6b = 48 ⇒ b = 8 cm. Length = 2(8) + 4 = 20 cm. Area = 20 × 8 = 160 sq cm.

Step-by-Step Solution: Breadth = 8 cm, Length = 20 cm. Area = 20 × 8 = 160 sq cm.

Common Mistake: Reporting perimeter/dimensions instead of area.

Quick Tip: Find b=8, L=20, Area = 20 × 8 = 160 sq cm.

Concept: Multiply by LCM 12: 3(x + 3) - 4(x - 2) = 2 ⇒ 3x + 9 - 4x + 8 = 2 ⇒ -x + 17 = 2 ⇒ -x = -15 ⇒ x = 15.

Step-by-Step Solution: -x + 17 = 2 ⇒ x = 15.

Common Mistake: Forgetting to distribute -4 to -2 (-4 × -2 = +8).

Quick Tip: Multiply entire equation by LCM 12.

questions.problem: What must be subtracted from 3a^2 - 4b^2 + 5ab to get -a^2 - b^2 + 6ab?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Required = (3a^2 - 4b^2 + 5ab) - (-a^2 - b^2 + 6ab) = 3a^2 - 4b^2 + 5ab + a^2 + b^2 - 6ab = 4a^2 - 3b^2 - ab.

Step-by-Step Solution: 4a^2 - 3b^2 - ab.

Common Mistake: Sign errors during subtraction.

Quick Tip: Subtract target from given.

questions.problem: A number consists of two digits whose sum is 9. If 27 is subtracted from the number, the digits are reversed. Find the number.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Let tens digit = t, units digit = u. t + u = 9. Number = 10t + u. 10t + u - 27 = 10u + t ⇒ 9t - 9u = 27 ⇒ t - u = 3. t = 6, u = 3. Number = 63.

Step-by-Step Solution: t + u = 9, t - u = 3 ⇒ t = 6, u = 3 ⇒ 63. Check: 63 - 27 = 36.

Common Mistake: Choosing 36 (36 - 27 = 9, not 63!).

Quick Tip: Test 63 - 27 = 36 (digits reversed!).

questions.problem: If x + 1/x = 5, find the value of x^2 + 1/x^2.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Square both sides: (x + 1/x)^2 = 5^2 ⇒ x^2 + 2(x)(1/x) + 1/x^2 = 25 ⇒ x^2 + 2 + 1/x^2 = 25 ⇒ x^2 + 1/x^2 = 23.

Step-by-Step Solution: 25 - 2 = 23.

Common Mistake: Thinking 5^2 = 25.

Quick Tip: (x + 1/x)^2 = x^2 + 2 + 1/x^2.

questions.problem: A purse contains ₹1, ₹2, and ₹5 coins in the ratio 3 : 2 : 1. If total value is ₹120, find the number of ₹5 coins.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Total value = Sum of (ratio × coin value).

Step-by-Step Solution: Let coins be 3x, 2x, 1x. Value = 3x(1) + 2x(2) + 1x(5) = 3x + 4x + 5x = 12x = 120 ⇒ x = 10. ₹5 coins = 1x = 10 coins.

Common Mistake: Dividing 120 by (3+2+1) = 6.

Quick Tip: Value equation: 3x + 4x + 5x = 12x = 120 ⇒ x = 10.

Concept: Multiply by 10 to clear decimals: 2(2x - 1) - 3(x + 1) = 5 ⇒ 4x - 2 - 3x - 3 = 5 ⇒ x - 5 = 5 ⇒ x = 10.

Step-by-Step Solution: x - 5 = 5 ⇒ x = 10.

Common Mistake: Decimals expansion error.

Quick Tip: Multiply whole equation by 10 first to eliminate decimals.

questions.problem: Find the value of p for which the expression 2x^2 + px - 3 equals 5 when x = -2.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Substitute x = -2: 2(-2)^2 + p(-2) - 3 = 5 ⇒ 2(4) - 2p - 3 = 5 ⇒ 8 - 2p - 3 = 5 ⇒ 5 - 2p = 5 ⇒ -2p = 0 ⇒ p = 0.

Step-by-Step Solution: 8 - 2p - 3 = 5 ⇒ 5 - 2p = 5 ⇒ p = 0.

Common Mistake: Writing (-2)^2 = -4.

Quick Tip: 8 - 3 = 5 ⇒ 5 - 2p = 5 ⇒ p = 0.

questions.problem: How many vertices, faces, and edges does an octagonal prism have?
questions.explanation:
Concept: n-gonal prism: Faces = n + 2, Vertices = 2n, Edges = 3n.

Step-by-Step Solution: n = 8: Faces = 10, Vertices = 16, Edges = 24. Euler: 10 + 16 - 24 = 2.

Common Mistake: Confusing prism with pyramid.

Quick Tip: Octagonal prism: 10 faces, 16 vertices, 24 edges.

questions.problem: Find the area of a ring between two concentric circles of radii 10 cm and 6 cm (Take π = 3.14).
questions.explanation:
Concept: Area of ring = π(R^2 - r^2) = 3.14 × (100 - 36) = 3.14 × 64 = 200.96 sq cm.

Step-by-Step Solution: 3.14 × 64 = 200.96 sq cm.

Common Mistake: Subtracting radii (10 - 6 = 4) first.

Quick Tip: Area = π(R^2 - r^2), NOT π(R - r)^2!

questions.problem: The diagonals of a rhombus are in the ratio 3 : 4. If its area is 96 sq cm, find the length of the shorter diagonal.
questions.explanation:
Concept: d1 = 3x, d2 = 4x. Area = 1/2 × 3x × 4x = 6x^2 = 96 => x = 4. d1 = 3 × 4 = 12 cm.

Step-by-Step Solution: 6x^2 = 96 => x = 4 => d1 = 12 cm.

Common Mistake: Reporting x = 4 as diagonal length.

Quick Tip: d1 = 3 × 4 = 12 cm, d2 = 4 × 4 = 16 cm.

questions.problem: Find the hypotenuse of an isosceles right triangle whose area is 32 sq cm.
questions.explanation:
Concept: 1/2 a^2 = 32 => a^2 = 64 => a = 8 cm. Hypotenuse c = sqrt(64 + 64) = sqrt(128) ≈ 11.31 cm.

Step-by-Step Solution: a = 8 cm. c = sqrt(128) ≈ 11.31 cm.

Common Mistake: Reporting leg a = 8 cm as hypotenuse.

Quick Tip: Hypotenuse = leg × sqrt(2) = 8 × 1.414 = 11.31 cm.
tags: Isosceles right triangle hypotenuse from area

questions.problem: A rectangular lawn 60 m by 40 m has two crossroads of width 2 m running through its center. Find the total area of the crossroads.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Path 1 = 120, Path 2 = 80, Overlap = 4. Total = 120 + 80 - 4 = 196 sq m.

Step-by-Step Solution: 120 + 80 - 4 = 196 sq m.

Common Mistake: Forgetting to subtract central 2m × 2m overlap.

Quick Tip: Subtract overlap area once!

questions.problem: If two parallel lines are cut by a transversal, and two alternate interior angles are (5x - 20)° and (3x + 10)°, find x.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Alternate interior angles are EQUAL.

Step-by-Step Solution: 5x - 20 = 3x + 10 => 2x = 30 => x = 15.

Common Mistake: Setting sum to 180°.

Quick Tip: Alternate interior angles are EQUAL.

questions.problem: Find the altitude h of a triangle whose base is 15 cm and area is equal to that of a square of side 6 cm.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Area of square = 36 sq cm. 1/2 × 15 × h = 36 => 7.5 h = 36 => h = 4.8 cm.

Step-by-Step Solution: 15h / 2 = 36 => 15h = 72 => h = 4.8 cm.

Common Mistake: Forgetting 1/2 in triangle area formula.

Quick Tip: h = (2 × 36) / 15 = 4.8 cm.

questions.problem: The area of a circle is 616 sq cm. Find its circumference (Take π = 22/7).
questions.explanation:
Concept: π r^2 = 616 => r^2 = 196 => r = 14 cm. Circumference = 2 π r = 88 cm.

Step-by-Step Solution: r = 14 cm. C = 88 cm.

Common Mistake: Reporting radius 14 cm as final answer.

Quick Tip: r^2 = 196 => r = 14 => C = 88 cm.

questions.problem: In a right triangle ABC right-angled at B, if AB = 5 cm and AC = 13 cm, find the area of triangle ABC.
questions.explanation:
Concept: BC = sqrt(AC^2 - AB^2) = sqrt(169 - 25) = sqrt(144) = 12 cm. Area = 1/2 × 5 × 12 = 30 sq cm.

Step-by-Step Solution: BC = 12 cm. Area = 1/2 × 5 × 12 = 30 sq cm.

Common Mistake: Calculating 1/2 × 5 × 13 = 32.5.

Quick Tip: Use legs AB and BC for base and height.

questions.problem: A wire in the shape of a rectangle 18 cm long and 10 cm wide is reshaped into a circle. Find the radius of the circle (Take π = 22/7).
questions.explanation:
Concept: Perimeter of rectangle = Circumference of circle.

Step-by-Step Solution: Perimeter = 2(18 + 10) = 56 cm. 2 × (22/7) × r = 56 => r = (56 × 7) / 44 = 8.91 cm.

Common Mistake: Using area instead of perimeter.

Quick Tip: Wire length = Perimeter = 56 cm.

questions.problem: A box contains numbered cards 1 to 20. What is the probability of drawing a card that is a MULTIPLE of 3 OR 5?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Multiples of 3: {3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18} (6 cards). Multiples of 5: {5, 10, 15, 20} (4 cards). Union: {3, 5, 6, 9, 10, 12, 15, 18, 20} (9 cards, since 15 is counted once!). Probability = 9 / 20.

Step-by-Step Solution: Favorable = 9 cards out of 20 = 9/20.

Common Mistake: Counting 15 twice (6 + 4 = 10/20 = 1/2).

Quick Tip: Do not count 15 twice! {3,5,6,9,10,12,15,18,20} = 9 cards.

questions.problem: A shape has an angle of rotation of 40°. How many lines of rotational symmetry order does it have?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Order = 360° / Angle of rotation = 360° / 40° = 9.

Step-by-Step Solution: 360 / 40 = 9.

Common Mistake: Writing 8.

Quick Tip: Order = 360 / 40 = 9.

questions.problem: A freezer cools at a rate of 3°C per hour. If room temperature is 30°C, how long will it take to reach -15°C?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Total temperature drop required = 30 - (-15) = 45°C. Time = 45 / 3 = 15 hours.

Step-by-Step Solution: 45 ÷ 3 = 15 hours.

Common Mistake: Taking temperature change as 30 - 15 = 15°C.

Quick Tip: Drop from +30 to -15 is 45°C.

Concept: 3 1/4 - 1 2/4 = 1 3/4 = 7/4. (7/4) × (2/7) = 2/4 = 1/2.

Step-by-Step Solution: 7/4 × 2/7 = 2/4 = 1/2.

Common Mistake: Subtracting whole numbers and fractions separately.

Quick Tip: 1 3/4 = 7/4. 7/4 × 2/7 = 1/2.

questions.problem: A man spends 70% of his income and saves ₹9,000 per month. Find his monthly income.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Savings % = 100% - 70% = 30%. 30/100 × Income = 9000 ⇒ Income = (9000 × 100)/30 = ₹30,000.

Step-by-Step Solution: Income = 9000 / 0.30 = ₹30,000.

Common Mistake: Calculating 70% of 9000.

Quick Tip: Savings is 30%. 9000 / 0.30 = 30,000.

questions.problem: In how many years will ₹5,000 amount to ₹6,500 at 6% p.a. SI?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Interest = 6500 - 5000 = ₹1,500. T = (1500 × 100)/(5000 × 6) = 150000 / 30000 = 5 years.

Step-by-Step Solution: T = 5 years.

Common Mistake: Using 6500 as interest.

Quick Tip: Interest = Amount - Principal = 1500. T = 1500 / 300 = 5 yrs.

questions.problem: A rectangular park is 45 m long and 30 m wide. A path of 2.5 m width is constructed OUTSIDE the park. Find the area of the path.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Outer dimensions: Length = 45 + 5 = 50 m, Width = 30 + 5 = 35 m. Outer Area = 50 × 35 = 1,750 sq m. Inner Area = 45 × 30 = 1,350 sq m. Path Area = 1,750 - 1,350 = 400 sq m.

Step-by-Step Solution: 1750 - 1350 = 400 sq m.

Common Mistake: Adding 2.5 m only once to length and width.

Quick Tip: Add 2 × path width (5 m) to both dimensions for outer rectangle.

questions.problem: A circular flower bed of radius 7 m is surrounded by a path of width 3.5 m. Find the area of the path (Take π = 22/7).
questions.explanation:
Concept: Inner radius r = 7 m. Outer radius R = 7 + 3.5 = 10.5 m = 21/2 m. Outer Area = (22/7) × (21/2)^2 = 346.5 sq m. Inner Area = (22/7) × 7^2 = 154 sq m. Path Area = 346.5 - 154 = 192.5... Wait: 22/7 × (10.5^2 - 7^2) = 22/7 × (10.5 - 7)(10.5 + 7) = 22/7 × 3.5 × 17.5 = 22 × 0.5 × 17.5 = 11 × 17.5 = 192.5 sq m.

Step-by-Step Solution: Inner r=7, Outer R=10.5. Path = π(R^2 - r^2) = (22/7) × (110.25 - 49) = (22/7) × 61.25 = 192.5 sq m.

Common Mistake: Subtracting radii instead of areas.

Quick Tip: Path area = π R^2 - π r^2 = π(R^2 - r^2).

questions.problem: A garden is in the form of a right triangle of legs 30 m and 40 m. Find the cost of fencing it at ₹15 per meter.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Hypotenuse = sqrt(30^2 + 40^2) = 50 m. Perimeter = 30 + 40 + 50 = 120 m. Cost = 120 × 15 = ₹1,800.

Step-by-Step Solution: Perimeter = 120 m. Cost = 120 × 15 = ₹1,800.

Common Mistake: Fencing only 2 legs (70 m × 15 = 1050).

Quick Tip: Find hypotenuse (50 m) to get total perimeter (120 m).

questions.problem: Find the measure of angle x if (x + 15)° and (2x - 30)° are vertically opposite angles.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Vertically opposite angles are EQUAL: x + 15 = 2x - 30 ⇒ 2x - x = 15 + 30 ⇒ x = 45°.

Step-by-Step Solution: x = 45°.

Common Mistake: Setting sum to 180°.

Quick Tip: Vertically opposite angles are EQUAL.

questions.problem: If the ratio of circumferences of two circles is 3 : 4, what is the ratio of their areas?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Ratio of circumferences = Ratio of radii = 3 : 4. Ratio of areas = r1^2 : r2^2 = 3^2 : 4^2 = 9 : 16.

Step-by-Step Solution: 3^2 : 4^2 = 9 : 16.

Common Mistake: Writing 3 : 4.

Quick Tip: Area ratio is the SQUARE of the radius/circumference ratio.
tags: Ratio of circumferences to ratio of areas

questions.problem: How many 3D faces, vertices, and edges does a pentagonal prism have?
questions.explanation:
Concept: Pentagonal prism: 2 pentagonal bases + 5 rectangular sides = 7 faces. 2 × 5 = 10 vertices. 3 × 5 = 15 edges.

Step-by-Step Solution: F = 7, V = 10, E = 15. Check Euler: 7 + 10 - 15 = 2.

Common Mistake: Confusing prism with pyramid.

Quick Tip: Prism with n-gon base has n+2 faces, 2n vertices, 3n edges.
tags: Pentagonal prism F V E properties

questions.problem: Find the area of a rhombus whose side is 10 cm and one diagonal is 12 cm.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Diagonals of a rhombus bisect each other at 90°. Half diagonal = 6 cm. Other half diagonal = sqrt(10^2 - 6^2) = 8 cm ⇒ d2 = 16 cm. Area = 1/2 × 12 × 16 = 96 sq cm.

Step-by-Step Solution: d2 = 16 cm. Area = 1/2 × 12 × 16 = 96 sq cm.

Common Mistake: Calculating 10 × 12 = 120.

Quick Tip: Half diagonals form right triangle with side as hypotenuse.
tags: Rhombus area from side and 1 diagonal

questions.problem: If SP of 10 articles equals CP of 12 articles, find the profit percentage.
questions.explanation:
Concept: Let CP of 1 article = ₹1. CP of 10 = ₹10. SP of 10 = CP of 12 = ₹12. Profit on 10 articles = ₹2. Profit % = (2/10) × 100% = 20%.

Step-by-Step Solution: Profit % = (2 / 10) × 100% = 20%.

Common Mistake: Calculating 2/12 = 16.66% (CP of 10 articles is 10, not 12!).

Quick Tip: Profit % is on CP of 10 articles (10). 2/10 = 20%.
tags: SP of N articles equals CP of M articles

questions.explanation:
Concept: Bases equal: (-3) + (-6) = 3x - 3 ⇒ -9 = 3x - 3 ⇒ 3x = -6 ⇒ x = -2.

Step-by-Step Solution: 3x = -6 ⇒ x = -2.

Common Mistake: Equating products instead of sums of exponents.

Quick Tip: -9 = 3x - 3 ⇒ 3x = -6 ⇒ x = -2.

questions.problem: A sum of ₹10,000 is borrowed at 12% p.a. for 3 years. Find total Interest.
questions.explanation:
Concept: I = (10000 × 12 × 3)/100 = 100 × 36 = ₹3,600.

Step-by-Step Solution: I = ₹3,600.

Common Mistake: Reporting Amount (13,600).

Quick Tip: 100 × 36 = 3,600.

questions.problem: From a circular sheet of radius 14 cm, two circles of radius 3.5 cm and a rectangle of length 3 cm and breadth 1 cm are removed. Find the area of the remaining sheet (Take π = 22/7).
questions.explanation:
Concept: Total Area = 22/7 × 14 × 14 = 616 sq cm. Removed 2 circles = 2 × (22/7 × 3.5 × 3.5) = 2 × 38.5 = 77 sq cm. Removed rectangle = 3 × 1 = 3 sq cm. Total removed = 77 + 3 = 80 sq cm. Remaining Area = 616 - 80 = 536 sq cm.

Step-by-Step Solution: 616 - 80 = 536 sq cm.

Common Mistake: Subtracting only 1 circle area.

Quick Tip: Remaining = Total - (2 × Circle + Rectangle).
